modules/chatManager.js.reason: Integrated chat behavior: selection subscriptions for topic side panes; clear old media before navigation; per-conversation side chat context/unread policy; explicit cancellation and non-streaming terminal settlement; one error notice per failed request. Reviewed auxiliary-side-chat reproduction: Stop during delayed history save or request preparation previously still sent generation; renderer-local AbortSignal checks now prevent that send. When upstream interrupt fails, await the existing local stream terminal before placeholder cleanup so accepted partial content is saved instead of deleted. Actual native side owner, internal renderer, manager, preload/IPC/disk and local HTTP before/after evidence; side preparation and partial-cancel regressions. Existing Surface routing and history authority remain in place. Main/group sending without the optional signal keeps its preparation path. Stop while awaiting the first HTTP headers: a locally aborted stream IPC return now awaits the already-owned cancellation terminal instead of showing a service-error notice; the regression keeps the submitted question and leaves the busy state. Non-streaming terminal save: a failed reply save (either { success: false } or the agent IPC { error } shape) now settles failed with a persistence error, so the auxiliary side chat shows its unsaved badge and blocks close like streaming does; covered by tests/side-chat-save-failure.test.mjs. Selection intent: onSelectionIntent fires as soon as selectTopic or selectItem sets the topic, before history renders, so the side pane follows a long topic immediately instead of showing the previous topic's side chat for seconds; onSelectionChange still fires on commit; covered by tests/chat-manager-selection-race.test.js. Stop on an unresponsive server: a non-streaming side chat reply settles cancelled locally first and notifies upstream without waiting, and the send no longer waits for the main-process request (which has no local abort) once its terminal is cancelled, so the composer unlocks at once and a late answer is not written into the stopped turn; covered by tests/side-chat-save-failure.test.mjs. Stop keeps what was already streamed: if the reply finishes by itself while a slow interrupt request is pending (the stream route is already released), the failed interrupt no longer deletes it as a placeholder; if upstream accepts the interrupt but never sends a terminal, the side chat stops locally after 3s and saves the partial as cancelled; covered by tests/side-chat-stop-partial.test.mjs.

modules/messageRenderer.js.reason: Integrated renderer behavior: nested tool result data isolation; lazy tool payload DOM; safe approval diagnostics; upstream tool-result hide/restore toggle, still persisted through historyMutationAuthority; upstream scanned-PDF page labels on attachments; owned media cleanup; cross-agent avatar projection; message-local pretext estimates drained from one per-window idle queue so they never starve batched history insertion. This records the integrated source boundary, not a guarantee of all data-write scenarios. Tool presentation: the renderer owns presenter teardown, reads appearance from its owner realm, captures disclosure before HTML replacement, and applies presentation after a valid render without changing protocol or persistence. Tool request cards escape the original request text once at output; the pipeline's field-escaped copy is only kept for daily-note Markdown. Upstream daf47b06 (独立工具渲染样式配置器) reviewed: introduces toolPresentation module scoped to the renderer realm — createToolPresentation({root, getLocalConfig, getProfile}) wired to chatMessagesDiv and appearance profile, capture() before HTML replacement, dispose() on teardown; no protocol, persistence or history-write path touched. Hash re-baselined accordingly. Decorative bubble animations are viewport-gated: the renderer installs modules/renderer/decorativeAnimationGate.js on the message list once (IntersectionObserver + MutationObserver toggling a class that pauses CSS animations on bubbles outside the viewport, paused flows under prefers-reduced-motion) and disposes it with the list; no render output, protocol, persistence or history-write path is touched. Hash re-baselined accordingly. Re-baselined against upstream main 994ef1930 (b322c4fb2/24628f000 架构重构, 0cb15ba5f 修复jevcall误报错) reviewed: tool request and tool result bodies are now mounted lazily (deferToolRequest/renderToolResultBlock register the raw block in a renderer-local map, mountLazyTool renders it on expand and tears it down on collapse, releaseLazyTools/clear drop entries on re-render and teardown); the ProjectForge topic surface observes assistant content per render root; tool-request marker diagnostics receive the block content; <<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>> counts as tool content for the summary detector. All of it is render-side DOM and in-memory state; no protocol, persistence or history-write path is touched, and the decorative animation gate still installs on the same message list.

modules/renderer/streamManager.js.reason: Integrated projection behavior: media cleanup before subtree replacement; nested tool-result ranges shield protocol markers; incremental smooth-stream burst handling preserves text order; durable persistence remains outside this projection. Frame scheduling is visibility-aware: while the owner document is hidden (requestAnimationFrame does not fire) frames are armed as timers and the whole backlog is drained; for 100 ms after the document becomes visible the backlog is still drained in full so text that arrived while hidden appears in the first visible frame. Protocol, persistence and the scheduler capability boundary are unchanged; this is what lets the main window keep the default Chromium background throttling. Re-baselined against upstream main 994ef1930 (f3e7186aa 增强边界竟态裁决, 60f1b28eb 重要架构优化3) reviewed: the stable-prefix scanner now accepts CRLF and whitespace-only blank lines as paragraph boundaries, validates tag starts before treating < as HTML, trusts a standalone <<<[END_ROLE_DIVIDE_USER]>>> line as a sealed boundary, scans bare <div> islands as one unit, keeps unclosed code/math at EOF without a trailing newline unstable, and never lets an unfinished tail revoke complete paragraphs before it. This only changes which prefix of the incoming text is projected as stable; the visibility-aware frame scheduling, protocol, persistence and the scheduler capability boundary are unchanged.

modules/topicListManager.js.reason: Integrated topic behavior: configuration/unread loads validate the selected item; sort/title/menu operations capture their original topic target; completed deletion changes the active view only for the same item and topic. Repository, readiness and render listener ownership remain unchanged. Topic search waits 200ms after typing before reloading (Enter is immediate); a rejected config IPC shows an error row instead of a permanent spinner; names and IPC errors render as text. Successful single and batch deletions report the deleted topic ids through mainRendererFunctions.onTopicsDeleted so the side pane drops tabs owned by those topics. Keyboard: topics are one roving tab stop (arrows/Home/End move, Enter/Space open, Shift+F10 or the menu key opens the context menu); the context menu is a role=menu with arrow navigation, Escape/Tab closing it back onto the topic.

modules/settingsManager.js.reason: Integrated manual-save policy: Agent/prompt edits remain drafts until Save; context changes and collapse no longer implicitly persist; submit captures draft and display identity; regex import merges into the draft; Lucide renders action icons. Replaces the obsolete autosave rationale. Settings display uses a local selection snapshot; a delayed config read cannot overwrite a newer settings view (frozen-selection and A-to-B display regression tests). Regex rule add/edit/delete and MiMo director prompt add/remove mark the draft unsaved like ordinary field edits. Unsaved Agent drafts (including after a failed save) are kept per Agent while the form shows another one and restored with a notice when it is shown again; Save or delete clears them. A draft whose name field was cleared keeps no name, so restoring it cannot save the Agent under the next Agent's name. The side-pane home portrait panel follows the same policy: chosen or removed portrait images are staged per Agent and written only on Save (before the config), its focus and height save as portraitDisplay with the form, and a successful save tells the side pane to redraw. The side pane portrait settings live inside the identity section's style disclosure, so they have no section controller or collapse state of their own. Re-baselined against upstream main (last touch: daf47b06 新增独立工具渲染样式配置器); hash drift reviewed, no Next-boundary semantics change detected in the delta.
